Nearby: German submarine U-629 was a Type VIIC U-boat built for Nazi Germany's Kriegsmarine for service during World War II.
She was laid down on 23 August 1941 by Blohm & Voss, Hamburg as yard number 605, launched on 12 May 1942 and commissioned on 2 July 1942 under Oberleutnant zur See Hans-Helmuth Bugs.

all.text: At this latitude, the Earth's spin carries the ship east at about 690 mph, whatever the captain is doing.
The sun reaches its highest point here about 16 minutes after it does in Southampton.
Drill straight through the Earth from here and you'd surface at 48.5°S, 174.6°E, about 430 km from Dunedin.
This far north, they're roughly level with Winnipeg, even though it's a world away.
The seabed is roughly 110 m below the ship.
